sloka: त्वां दृष्ट्वा प्रियवक्तारं संप्रहृष्यामि वानर ।अर्धसञ्जातसस्येव वृष्टिं प्राप्य वसुन्धरा ।। ५.४०.२।।।।
transliteration: tvāṁ dṛṣṭvā priyavaktāraṁ saṁprahṛṣyāmi vānara ।ardhasañjātasasyeva vṛṣṭiṁ prāpya vasundharā ।। 5.40.2।।।।

translations.english: "O vanara just as the earth feels happy when the half grown crops receive rain, I feel happy after seeing you. You have been speaking pleasing words
